availability_rule_row_kind_check.name: availability_rule_row_kind_check
availability_rule_row_kind_check.value:
(
        "availability_rule"."resourceId" is null
        and "availability_rule"."weeklyHours" is not null
        and "availability_rule"."timezone" is not null
        and "availability_rule"."minimumNoticeMinutes" is not null
        and "availability_rule"."horizonDays" is not null
        and "availability_rule"."closedDates" is not null
      ) or (
        "availability_rule"."resourceId" is not null
        and "availability_rule"."timezone" is null
        and "availability_rule"."minimumNoticeMinutes" is null
        and "availability_rule"."horizonDays" is null
        and "availability_rule"."closedDates" is null
        and "availability_rule"."holidayCountry" is null
        and "availability_rule"."holidayRegion" is null
        and "availability_rule"."closedHolidays" = '[]'::jsonb
      )

availability_rule_region_needs_country_c.name: availability_rule_region_needs_country_check
availability_rule_region_needs_country_c.value: "availability_rule"."holidayRegion" is null or "availability_rule"."holidayCountry" is not null

activity_next_steps_index.name: activity_next_steps_index
activity_next_steps_index.where: "activity"."dueAt" is not null and "activity"."doneAt" is null

activity_kind_check.name: activity_kind_check
activity_kind_check.value: ("activity"."occurredAt" is not null) <> ("activity"."dueAt" is not null)

activity_done_needs_due_check.name: activity_done_needs_due_check
activity_done_needs_due_check.value: "activity"."doneAt" is null or "activity"."dueAt" is not null
